name: Starter Desk
description: A plain wooden desk. Every lab starts somewhere.

name: Desk Chair
description: Rolls, spins, and squeaks a little.

name: Open Shelf
description: Room for binders, samples, and snacks.

name: Potted Plant
description: Needs light and water, like the plants in your cases.

name: Beaker
description: Holds and pours liquids. The marks on the side are for estimating.

name: Flask
description: The narrow neck means fewer splashes when you swirl.

name: Line Graph Poster
description: A line graph shows how something changes.

name: Lab White
description: Clean and bright.

name: Lilac Gray
description: The floor every lab starts with.

name: Purple
description: The classic Lab for Hire purple.

name: Plain
description: No pattern.

name: Microscope
description: Magnifies things too small to see. Unlocks cell cases (7.LS1.1, 7.LS1.2).

name: Grow Cabinet
description: A mini greenhouse with its own grow light. Unlocks plant growth cases (7.LS1.4).

name: Materials Tester
description: Stretches and squeezes samples so you can compare them fairly. Unlocks medical design cases (7.ETS1.1).

name: Calorimeter
description: Measures heat given off or taken in. Unlocks reaction cases (7.PS3.1).

name: Test Tube Rack
description: Three samples side by side, easy to compare.

name: Lab Bench
description: A real lab bench with a tough dark top.

name: Power Generator
description: Hums quietly. Mostly for looks.

name: Round Rug
description: Soft, round, and a little bit fancy.

name: Long Rug
description: Covers more floor.

name: Bar Graph Poster
description: A bar graph compares groups.

name: Scatter Plot Poster
description: A scatter plot helps you spot a trend.

name: Bookcase
description: Solid sides keep your stuff from falling out.

name: Cushion Chair
description: Less rolling, more comfy.

name: Stack of Books
description: Field guides and lab manuals.

name: Lab Cat
description: Supervises every experiment.

name: Lab Dog
description: Very excited about your data.

name: Lab Bunny
description: Twitchy nose, big ears.

name: Lavender
description: A soft purple glow.

name: Mint
description: Cool and calm.

name: Periwinkle
description: A floor with a little blue in it.

name: Teal
description: Trim with a splash of teal.

name: Checker
description: Big checkerboard tiles.

name: Stripes
description: Wide floor stripes.

name: Work Table
description: A second table out on the floor. Holds two more pieces of equipment.

name: Any Color Walls
description: Pick any color you want for your walls, and change it whenever you like.

name: Any Color Floor
description: Pick any color you want for your floor, and change it whenever you like.

name: Any Color Trim
description: Pick any color you want for your trim, and change it whenever you like.

name: Mary Jackson Poster
description: NASA's first Black woman engineer. She tested airplane designs in wind tunnels.

name: Neil deGrasse Tyson Poster
description: An astrophysicist who makes space science fun, on TV and in books.

name: Marie Curie Poster
description: Discovered two new elements and was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes.

name: Nikola Tesla Poster
description: An inventor who helped bring alternating current (AC) electricity into homes.

name: Ada Lovelace Poster
description: Wrote what many call the first computer program, back in the 1840s.

name: Albert Einstein Poster
description: A physicist famous for E = mc² and new ideas about space, time, and light.

name: Your Graph
description: A framed copy of a graph you made yourself. It can't be bought: you earn it by doing great work on a case.

name: Candle Cluster
description: Frankenstein pack. Spooky light for late-night experiments.

name: Candle Lantern
description: Frankenstein pack. Lights up the front corner.

name: Jack-o'-lantern
description: Frankenstein pack. Carved and grinning.

name: Spark Coil
description: Frankenstein pack. Big sparks, no real science. Just for looks.

name: Stormy
description: Frankenstein pack. A gloomy, stormy-night gray.
